source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: قدام بيتنا، كانت في شجرة توت كبيرة.
sentences.en: In front of our house, there was a big mulberry tree.

sentences.ar: كانت تتغير مع كل فصل بالسنة.
sentences.en: It would change with every season of the year.

sentences.ar: بالربيع، كانت تلبس ورق أخضر وزهر.
sentences.en: In spring, it would wear green leaves and blossoms.

sentences.ar: بالصيف، كانت تعطينا ظل وتوت حلو.
sentences.en: In summer, it would give us shade and sweet mulberries.

sentences.ar: الولاد كانوا يطلعوا عليها ياكلوا التوت.
sentences.en: The kids would climb it to eat the mulberries.
In fall, its leaves would yellow and fall.
We would play with the dry leaves and gather them.

sentences.ar: وبالشتا، كانت تصير عريانة، بس واقفة بقوة.
sentences.en: And in winter, it would become bare, but standing strong.

sentences.ar: جدي كان يقول: هالشجرة متل الإنسان.
sentences.en: My grandfather would say: this tree is like a human being.
He said: it goes through seasons, good and hard.

sentences.ar: قال: المهم تضل واقف متل الشجرة بالشتا.
sentences.en: He said: what matters is to stay standing like the tree in winter.
I grew up, and understood my grandfather's wisdom more.

sentences.ar: الحياة إلها فصول، وكل فصل بيعدي.
sentences.en: Life has seasons, and every season passes.

sentences.ar: والصعب بيروح، متل ما الشتا بيروح.
sentences.en: And hardship goes away, just as winter goes away.

sentences.ar: والشجرة، متل الأمل، بترجع تخضر من جديد.
sentences.en: And the tree, like hope, turns green again.
